Keep model answers on disk

Source: R/cache.R
sc_cache.Rd

sc_cache() sets up the response cache that generate_synthetic() and cognitive_interview() use. Every answer a model gives is saved in a folder, under a key made of everything that shapes the answer: The provider, the model id, the temperature, the address of the API, the system prompt (the persona), the prompts (the instructions, scale and items, in the order asked), and which respondent, attempt, interview and retry it is, with the run's seed. When the same call comes again, the saved answer is used instead of a new call. That makes a run repeatable and costs nothing the second time.

Usage

sc_cache(dir = sc_cache_dir(), mode = c("reuse", "refresh", "off"))

Arguments

dir

the folder of the cache. The default is tools::R_user_dir("synthcheck", "cache"), or the option synthcheck.cache_dir when it is set.

mode

"reuse" (use saved answers and save new ones), "refresh" (always ask the model and replace the saved answers) or "off" (neither read nor write the cache).

Value

An object of class sc_cache.

Details

Because the respondent, attempt and seed are part of the key, the respondents of one run still get separate calls. Running the same settings again gives the same data. More attempts or more respondents add new calls for the new ones only. A new seed, mode = "refresh" or a change to any prompt, model or setting asks the model again. Answers from provider = "mock" are never saved, since they cost nothing.

Calls that fail are not saved, so a rerun tries them again. Invalid answers (out of range or missing items) are saved like any other answer, and the retry that followed is saved under its own key.

The cache holds answers only: No API keys. It lives in tools::R_user_dir() unless you give another folder. See what it holds with sc_cache_info() and delete it with sc_cache_clear().

See also

sc_cache_info(), sc_cache_clear(), estimate_cost()

Examples

sc_cache()
#> Response cache in /home/runner/.cache/R/synthcheck: reuses saved answers and saves new ones.
sc_cache(tempfile("cache"), mode = "refresh")
#> Response cache in /tmp/RtmpNA9o65/cache188441b103d2: asks the models again and replaces saved answers.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
ins <- sc_instrument(hexaco_items[1:10, ], scale = c(1, 7))
a <- generate_synthetic(ins, sc_model("anthropic"), respondents = 5)
b <- generate_synthetic(ins, sc_model("anthropic"), respondents = 5) # from the cache
identical(a, b)
} # }
